description: This PHP source file provides a web interface for resetting and restoring a network gateway device. It includes HTML markup, embedded PHP for session variables, and JavaScript code for handling user interactions such as resetting the device, Wi-Fi, password, and other configurations through confirmation dialogs and AJAX requests.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends a request to perform a reset or restore operation on the device, handling progress indication and reboot checks.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Checks if the device has rebooted by sending a GET request and redirects to the login page upon success.

methods.name: setBatteryInfo
methods.description: Sends a request to restore battery connection settings.
